This file is shown when opening an issue or pull request. Please include a descriptive title, clear reproduction steps (for bugs), expected vs actual behavior, and any relevant logs or test steps so maintainers can triage your report quickly.

Quick checklist

- Describe the problem or feature clearly in the title and body.
- For bugs: include steps to reproduce, expected vs actual behavior, and relevant logs or stack traces.
- For PRs: describe what changed, why, and how to test it locally.
- Run tests and linters before submitting a PR and reference the CI status.

If this repository follows a specific contribution process (for example, an EIP-style proposal process), explain which parts contributors should follow and link to authoritative docs.

EIP / protocol-proposal note

This project is not primarily an Ethereum EIP repository. The EIP-1 process linked below only applies if you are submitting a protocol-level proposal; for normal issues and pull requests follow the guidance in this CONTRIBUTING document. If you are proposing a protocol or standards-level change using an EIP-style process, please review EIP-1: https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-1
